entries.title: SEC grants accelerated approval to Nasdaq ISE listing criteria for options on trusts holding digital commodities
entries.facts: In Release No. 34-106863 (File No. SR-ISE-2026-42), dated November 10, 2026, the SEC issued a Notice of Filing of Amendment No. 2 and an Order Granting Accelerated Approval of a Nasdaq ISE proposed rule change, as modified by Amendment No. 2, to amend the criteria for underlying securities. The filing amends Options 4, Section 3 to adopt listing criteria for options on Commodity-Based Trust Shares that hold one or more digital commodities, and replaces the term "crypto asset" with the term "digital commodity." Under the criteria as filed, each digital commodity held by the trust must underlie a derivatives contract trading on a market covered by a comprehensive surveillance sharing agreement, subject to an exception under which up to 15% of the NAV of the trust's holdings in the aggregate may consist of other holdings, and each digital commodity held by the trust, including those within that 15% buffer, must independently satisfy a $700 million average daily market-value test. The order was published in the Federal Register on November 13, 2026 at 91 FR 73355 as document 2026-23180.
entries.relevant_to: options exchanges, digital-asset ETP issuers, market makers, broker-dealers

entries.title: White House sends four SEC and CFTC nominations to the Senate
entries.facts: A White House "Nominations Sent to the Senate" notice published November 12, 2026 lists four nominations to the Securities and Exchange Commission and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission. Nathan Anonick, of Virginia, is nominated to be a Commissioner of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission for a term expiring June 19, 2031, vice Rostin Behnam, term expired. Kristin N. Johnson, of Michigan, is nominated to be a Member of the Securities and Exchange Commission for a term expiring June 5, 2029, vice Caroline A. Crenshaw, term expired. Steven Levine, of Maryland, is nominated to be a Member of the Securities and Exchange Commission for a term expiring June 5, 2030, vice Hester Maria Peirce, term expired. Matthew Rowland, of the District of Columbia, is nominated to be a Commissioner of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission for the remainder of the term expiring April 13, 2028, vice Summer K. Mersinger. The notice states no hearing or confirmation date.
entries.source_label: The White House, Nominations Sent to the Senate, November 12, 2026
entries.relevant_to: crypto exchanges, derivatives market participants, prediction-market platforms, fintech firms
